cohort: 114,409 singleton pregnancies in Ontario, Canada, conceptions dating from January 11, 2013 until January 10, 2014, delivered at ≥20 weeks gestation, excluding those younger than 18 years or with twin pregnancies
finding: While IVF was associated with an increased risk of severe maternal morbidity, and high BMI was modestly associated with severe  maternal morbidity, there was no synergistic effect of both factors.
